# Dortun Dynamics

Dortun Dynamics specializes in satellite imagery analytics focused on insurance and emergency response sectors. Their flagship product, CatastroMap, delivers rapid damage detection following natural disasters by analyzing satellite data to identify flood extents and roof damage. This enables insurers to expedite claims processing and emergency responders to prioritize resource allocation effectively.

Currently, CatastroMap is integrated into 15 major insurer claims platforms, achieving an 85% accuracy rate in damage alerts during recent hurricane and flood events. Dortun Dynamics has secured $12 million in Series A funding led by NovaTech Ventures, positioning them for scaling operations and expanding into earthquake response analytics.

The core team combines expertise in geospatial data science, insurance risk modeling, and software engineering, with CTO Halvane Solano and CEO Dramere Dorow at the helm. Competitors include ParallaxVision and TerraShield Analytics, both offering similar satellite-based risk assessments.

Open risks involve data latency during high cloud coverage events and ongoing verification of damage classifications in complex urban environments. The team is actively developing multi-modal sensor fusion to mitigate these challenges.
